questions.question: Dr. Sidki has an assistant on an 8-month fixed-term contract who becomes pregnant. Dr. Mourad informs her about her rights. According to Article 159, what happens at the end of the contract?
options: The contract is automatically extended until the end of maternity leave
The contract ends at its term, even during maternity leave
The contract is converted into a permanent contract
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 159 provides that the protective provisions for pregnant women do not prevent the expiry of the fixed-term contract.' Dr. Sidki: 'The contract will end at its term.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad wishes to dismiss an employee for gross misconduct. Dr. Sidki reminds him of the procedure. According to Article 62, within what period must he hear the employee after the notification of the act?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 62 provides that the employee must be heard within a period not exceeding eight days from the date of notification of the act.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will summon the employee quickly.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki has an employee who resigned. Dr. Mourad reminds her of the formalities. According to Article 34, must the resignation be signed by the employee before an authority?
options: No, a simple letter is sufficient
Yes, the signature must be legalized
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 34 provides that resignation must be made by a letter bearing a signature legalized by the competent authority.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will wait for the official letter.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad, employer of 12 employees, wishes to modify the internal regulations. Dr. Sidki informs him about the procedure. According to Article 138, what procedure must be followed?
options: He can modify it freely without formalities
He must communicate it to the staff delegates and submit it for ministry approval
He must submit it to a vote of the employees
He must only display it in the practice
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 138 requires the employer to communicate the internal regulations to the staff delegates before submitting them for approval by the government authority.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will follow this procedure.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki has an employee who refuses to comply with safety rules. Dr. Mourad informs her about the sanctions. According to Article 293, can an informed employee be sanctioned?
options: Yes, if they have been informed of the risks
Yes, but only after an accident
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 293 provides that employees informed of safety rules who do not comply with them are liable to sanctions.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will remind them of the rules and sanction if necessary.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad has an assistant taking annual leave. Dr. Sidki asks him about the duration. According to Article 231, after how many months of continuous service is the employee entitled to paid annual leave?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 231 provides that after six months of continuous service, every employee is entitled to paid annual leave.' Dr. Mourad: 'My assistant has more than 6 months, she is entitled to it.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki, employer of 60 employees, must create an occupational medical service. Dr. Mourad informs her of her obligations. According to Article 304, what must she do?
options: Create an independent occupational medical service
Just provide a first aid kit
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 304 requires the creation of an independent occupational medical service for companies employing at least 50 employees.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will create this service.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad has an employee on a permanent contract for 4 years. He wishes to dismiss him for economic reasons. Dr. Sidki informs him about severance pay. According to Article 53, how many hours of salary does the severance pay represent for the first 5 years?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 53 sets severance pay at 96 hours of salary for the first five years of seniority.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will calculate the severance pay on this basis.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki wishes to hire a foreign employee. Dr. Mourad informs her about the procedure. According to Article 516, the employer must obtain authorization from:
options: The embassy of the country of origin
The government authority responsible for labor
The Council of the Order of Dentists
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 516 requires any employer wishing to recruit a foreign employee to obtain authorization from the government authority responsible for labor.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will make the request.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad has an employee who committed gross misconduct. Dr. Sidki asks him if he must pay compensation. According to Article 61, does dismissal for gross misconduct exempt from payment?
options: Yes, but notice indemnity is due
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 61 provides that in the event of gross misconduct, the employee may be dismissed without notice or indemnity or payment of damages.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will therefore pay nothing.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki, employer of 25 employees, must organize staff delegate elections. According to Article 438, who is an elector?
options: Employees aged 16 and over with at least 6 months of work
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 438 provides that electors are employees of both sexes aged sixteen and over who have worked at least six months in the establishment.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will prepare the elections.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad has an assistant on maternity leave. Dr. Sidki asks him about the duration of the prohibition of work after childbirth. According to Article 153, for how many weeks can the employee not be employed?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 153 provides that employees who have given birth cannot be employed during the period of seven consecutive weeks following childbirth.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will respect this period.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki has an employee who resigned. Dr. Mourad reminds her of the formalities. According to Article 72, within what period must she issue the work certificate?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 72 requires the employer to issue the work certificate within a maximum period of eight days, under penalty of damages.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will prepare it immediately.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad, employer of 60 employees, must create a safety and health committee. According to Article 336, is this mandatory?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 336 provides for the creation of safety and health committees in companies employing at least 50 employees.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will create this committee.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki has an assistant who works overtime. Dr. Mourad informs her about the supplements. According to Article 201, what is the rate for night hours?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 201 provides for a 50% supplement for overtime worked between 9pm and 6am.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will apply this rate.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad has an employee on a permanent contract who wishes to resign. Dr. Sidki reminds him of the formalities. According to Article 34, the resignation must be made by:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 34 provides that the employee may terminate the permanent contract by means of a resignation bearing a signature legalized by the competent authority.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will wait for the official letter.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki has an employee who refused to perform dangerous work. Dr. Mourad informs her about the employee's rights. According to Article 293, can the employee be sanctioned if they have been informed of the risks?
options: Yes, if they have been informed of the risks
No, they can refuse any work
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 293 provides that employees duly informed of safety rules who do not comply with them are liable to sanctions.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will remind them of the rules.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad has an assistant who is entitled to annual leave. Dr. Sidki asks him about the duration. According to Article 231, the duration of paid annual leave is:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 231 sets the duration of paid annual leave at one and a half days of actual work per month of service.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will calculate my assistant's leave.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki, employer of 15 employees, wishes to establish internal regulations. Dr. Mourad informs her of the obligations. According to Article 138, what is the deadline to establish internal regulations?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 138 provides that the employer habitually employing at least ten employees is required, within two years of opening, to establish internal regulations.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will draft them.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad has an employee on a permanent contract for 3 years. He wishes to dismiss him for gross misconduct. According to Article 61, is the employee entitled to compensation?
options: No, dismissal for gross misconduct exempts from any payment
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 61 provides that in the event of gross misconduct, the employee may be dismissed without notice or indemnity or payment of damages.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will therefore pay nothing.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki has an assistant on a 3-month fixed-term contract. Dr. Mourad asks her about the duration of the probation period. According to Article 14, what is the maximum duration of the probation period for a fixed-term contract of less than 6 months?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 14 provides that the probation period for fixed-term contracts cannot exceed one day per week of work, up to a limit of two weeks for contracts under 6 months.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will plan for 2 weeks of probation.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad has an employee who committed gross misconduct. Dr. Sidki reminds him of the procedure. According to Article 62, the employee must be heard in the presence of:
options: The employee delegate or union representative
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 62 provides that the employee must be heard in the presence of the employee delegate or union representative.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will invite the staff delegate.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki, employer of 25 employees, must organize staff delegate elections. According to Article 433, how many titular delegates must she have?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 433 provides that from 10 to 25 employees, the company must elect one titular delegate and one alternate delegate.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will organize the election of one delegate.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad has an employee who resigned without respecting the notice period. Dr. Sidki informs him about the consequences. According to the Labor Code, can the employer withhold part of the salary?
options: No, the salary is due in full
Yes, a notice compensation indemnity can be withheld
Yes, but only with the employee's agreement
No, the employer cannot withhold anything
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'The employer may withhold a notice compensation indemnity corresponding to the salary not worked.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will withhold the corresponding indemnity.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki, after managing several complex HR situations with Dr. Mourad, receives his congratulations. What is the next step for Dr. Sidki?
options: Become an expert in dental labor law
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Mastery of labor law is a valuable skill. Becoming an expert is the next step.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will train in labor law.'
